title: Semester and Locker
author: Ivo Ashgrove
blurb: Tamsin Oyelaran, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide who to be when the labels come off before the last game of the season.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
